title: 为了 V1 而 V2 (V2 in order to V1)
longExplanation: V2 in order to V1. Pinyin: wèile V1 ér V2

title: 为了 N 而 V (V for N)
longExplanation: V for N. Pinyin: wèile N ér V

examples.sentence: 植物会为了阳光、空气和水而竞争。
examples.romanization: zhíwù huì wèile yángguāng、 kōngqì hé shuǐ ér jìngzhēng。
examples.translation: Plants compete for sunlight, air, and water.

examples.sentence: 就算在几公里深的海底也仍然能看到东西。
examples.romanization: jiùsuàn zài jǐ gōnglǐ shēn de hǎidǐ yě réngrán néng kàn dào dōngxi。
examples.translation: Even at a few kilometers deep on the sea floor, you can still see things.

examples.sentence: 不过她这么小，这本书我不知道她是否能读懂。
examples.romanization: bùguò tā zhème xiǎo， zhè běn shū wǒ bù zhīdào tā shìfǒu néng dúdǒng。
examples.translation: But she is so young, I don't know if she can read this book.

examples.sentence: 我真的受不了你了，你到底还要逛多久？
examples.romanization: wǒ zhēn de shòubùliǎo nǐ le， nǐ dàodǐ hái yào guàng duōjiǔ？
examples.translation: I really can't tolerate you, how long do you have to keep shopping?

title: 接着 V (continue to V)
longExplanation: continue to V. Pinyin: jiēzhe V

examples.sentence: 你看完这本书以后先不要还，我接着看。
examples.romanization: nǐ kàn wán zhè běn shū yǐhòu xiān bùyào hái， wǒ jiēzhe kàn。
examples.translation: Don't pay back after reading this book, I will continue to watch.

examples.sentence: 他毕业后在老家工作了一年，接着又考上了北京大学，读研究生。
examples.romanization: tā bìyè hòu zài lǎojiā gōngzuò le yī nián， jiēzhe yòu kǎoshàng le Běijīng Dàxué， dú yánjiūshēng。
examples.translation: After graduating, he worked in his hometown for a year. And then he was admitted to Peking University to study for graduate students.

title: 除此以外 (other than that)
longExplanation: other than that. Pinyin: chú cǐ yǐwài

examples.sentence: 他和弟弟同一天出生，兄弟俩长得很像，但除此以外几乎再找不到其他共同点。
examples.romanization: tā hé dìdi tóngyī tiān chūshēng， xiōngdì liǎ zhǎngde hěn xiàng， dàn chú cǐ yǐwài jīhū zài zhǎobudào qítā gòngtóngdiǎn。
examples.translation: He and his brother were born on the same day. The two brothers look very much alike, but other than that they can hardly find other things in common.

title: 把 N1 叫作 N2 (call N1 N2)
longExplanation: call N1 N2. Pinyin: bǎ N1 jiàozuò N2

examples.sentence: 中国人把黄河叫作“母亲河” 。
examples.romanization: Zhōngguórén bǎ Huáng Hé jiàozuò“ mǔqīn hé” 。
examples.translation: The Chinese call the Yellow River Mother River.

title: (无论/不管) Q 都 (no matter Q)
longExplanation: no matter Q. Pinyin: ( wúlùn/ bùguǎn) Q dōu

examples.sentence: 没关系，不用道歉，(无论/不管) 谁都有粗心填错的时候。
examples.romanization: méiguānxi， bùyòng dàoqiàn，( wúlùn/ bùguǎn) shéi dōu yǒu cūxīn tián cuò de shíhou。
examples.translation: It doesn't matter, don't apologize, anyone (lit. no matter who) can make a mistake.

title: V 上 (get to V)

examples.romanization: kànlai jīntiān chībushàng yángròu jiǎozi le。
examples.translation: It seems that I don’t get to eat lamb dumplings today.

title: V 出来 (V out (an outcome is produced))

examples.sentence: 这个公司总的来说还不错。
人们常说“生命在于运动”。
examples.translation: People often say that life is all about moving/exercising.”
